items.headline: High Surf Advisory issued November 18 at 4:56PM PST until November 20 at 4:00AM PST by NWS San Francisco CA
items.description:
* WHAT...Large breaking waves of 18 to 24 ft with up to 30 ft at
favored break points.

* WHERE...All Pacific Coast Beaches.

* WHEN...Until 4 AM PST Friday.

* IMPACTS...Large breaking waves can overpower swimmers, pulling
people into the sea from beaches, jetties, and rocks resulting
in significant physical injury and increasing the risk of
drowning. Waves can sweep across the shoreline without warning,
pulling people into the sea from beaches, jetties, and rocks.
items.instruction:
Swimmers should remain out of the water due to dangerous surf
conditions.

items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued November 19 at 2:37AM PST until November 19 at 3:00PM PST by NWS San Francisco CA
items.description:
* WHAT...West winds 15 to 25 kt with gusts up to 30 kt and seas
8 to 13 ft.

* WHERE...Coastal Waters from Point Reyes to Pigeon Point
California out to 10 NM.

* WHEN...Until 3 PM PST this afternoon.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller
vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.
